items.source:
Instantiate the given set of class name, injecting constructor arguments as
necessary.
items.translation: 实例化给定的类名集合，必要时注入构造函数参数。

items.source: Create a new Instantiator instance for the given type.
items.translation: 为给定类型创建一个新的Instantiator实例。

items.source: availableParameters - consumer used to register available parameters
items.translation: availableParameters - 消费者用于注册可用参数

items.source: Instantiate the given class, injecting constructor arguments as necessary.
items.translation: 实例化给定的类，必要时注入构造函数参数。

items.source: Instantiate the given set of classes, injecting constructor arguments as necessary.
items.translation: 实例化给定的类集，必要时注入构造函数参数。

items.source:
Get an injectable argument instance for the given type. This method can be used
when manually instantiating an object without reflection.
items.translation: 获取给定类型的可注入参数实例。当不使用反射手动创建对象时，可以使用此方法。

items.source: failureHandler - a Instantiator.FailureHandler that will be called in case of failure when instantiating objects
items.translation: `failureHandler` - 一个 Instantiator.FailureHandler，在实例化对象失败时将被调用。

items.source: Simple factory used to instantiate objects by injecting available parameters.
items.translation: 简单工厂通过注入可用参数来实例化对象。

items.source: Callback used to register available parameters.
items.translation: 用于注册可用参数的回调。

items.source: Strategy for handling a failure that occurs when instantiating a type.
items.translation: 处理实例化类型时发生失败的策略。

items.source: Get an injectable argument instance for the given type.
items.translation: 获取给定类型的可注入参数实例。
